title: The cpu-ml-v1 qualification suite is frozen, valid and reproducible
user_story: As the owner I want the L3 campaign to run a suite fixed before any run: 4 small CPU-scale ML cases with fixed data, budgets and stopping rules, as decided on 2026-10-29 (agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md B1; RQ-13).

requirements.description: devtools/qualification/cpu-ml-v1/suite.json is frozen by the sha256 of its canonical JSON (suite-digest.txt); suite.load refuses a changed or invalid suite.
Every dataset regenerates byte for byte (standard library, LF, 6 decimals) to the sha256 recorded in the suite; open-ended cases have held-out data with a different seed, given to the verifier only.
campaign_template starts the B5 campaign record with the suite digest and 4 planned cases; unmeasured, every criterion is NOT_RUN.

nonfunctional: Regenerating all 6 datasets takes under 10 s
Owner budget: 40 turns, 2 restarts, 7200 s per case, Codex
outputs: validated suite; datasets; campaign record template
postconditions: Every campaign run uses exactly this frozen suite

scenarios.expected: 2 guided + 2 open cases, 40/2/7200 budget, Codex, all 14 criteria measured by some case
All datasets regenerate to their sha256, deterministically, without CR
Open cases have held-out data with another seed; guided cases none
An edited budget makes the suite refuse to load
Missing held-out data, unknown criteria and no stopping rules are reported
The empty campaign is NOT_RUN everywhere with 4 planned cases
6 datasets regenerated and checked in under 10 s

recovery: Never edit a frozen suite; freeze a new version. TASK-SUITE-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Repository suite files; temporary copies for the edit test; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/suite-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on 6c7fa3b, all failing (no suite or loader). GREEN: 7/7.
